profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Booz Allen Hamilton
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the hospital & health care industry. Skilled in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, RabbitMQ, Cloud Services, Pivotal Cloud Foundary (Cloud Platform), Splunk, AngularJS, NodeJS, JavaScript, JQuery, APIs, HTML, CSS,, ElasticSearch, MySQL, MongoDB and graph databases . Strong engineering professional with a Masters focused in Information Systems from New Jersey Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Microservices architecture was designed and implemented to automate detecting prescription errors before drugs are dispensed at CVS Pharmacies saving pharmacists manual work enabling customer satisfaction. Integration with existing Pharmacist workflows was implemented as a first cloud microservices project which is used as a foundation currently for other businesses funded projects.
•	Designed MongoDB collection schemas/sharding strategies for new business initiatives for fast and high availability data retrieval across data centers. Implemented MongoDB aggregation queries, bulk inserts, connection pooling, and read/write preferences with Spring Boot.
•	High transaction throughput Microservices with fast response times were developed using Spring Boot utilizing Spring Cloud Services disaggregating existing monolithic application. Performance tuning issues were triaged and solutions were provided during performance tests. Tuning of application instances and memory allocations were done during performance tests.
•	Lead developer for team of developers, performed code reviews, code cleanliness, code security scans, resolved development design/technical hurdles, worked with integrating system teams, first point of contact for triaging production issues 
•	Designed and implemented retry mechanism using Spring Scheduler/RabbitMQ/MongoDB for failed transaction events sent for analytical purposes.
•	Proof of concept scanning desktop application with JavaFX was developed for scanning pharmacy documents along with meta data for a business initiative using MongoDB GridFS.
•	Splunk alerts/dashboards/reports were created for business and triaging production issues

positions.title: Sr. Big Data Developer
positions.description:
• Architected and developed an innovative patent pending product with 700+ users enabling various application team members to gain insights of their current technology landscape across the enterprise and view impacts for changes to production code.
• SME for product platform development.
• Led web development team with key responsibilities that included designing new functionalities by translating business requirements to IT requirements for both front end and APIs, managing code quality, deploying releases to production, mentoring developers debug issues/errors faced.
• Hands on experience with web development technologies (Spring MVC, AngularJS, d3.js, NPM, Gulp), APIs (using Java), and schema free stores (Elasticsearch, OWL Web Ontology, and OrientDB graph database.

positions.title: Application Security Architect
positions.description:
• Responsible for creating current and future states of the enterprise architecture for Web/Mobile Applications and Networks.
• Collaborated with architects for existing implemented designs to create a Component Context Diagram (CCD).
• Researched best practices from Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) and other standard protocols to design a future state of the enterprise architecture.
• Performed web application security reviews before an application goes to production ensuring login, authentication, data encryption, and other standards are met.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
• Proposed to develop a web application that can be utilized to store and update insurance claim field mappings previously maintained in excel.
• Developed an automated process to insert existing claim field mappings to MySQL database from excel using Java.
• Engaged with SMEs for in depth understanding of field dependencies to create a database schema.
• Developed dynamic web application using Spring MVC framework, Java Servlet Pages (JSP), JavaScript, JQuery, HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap toolkit, and created servlets for accessing data and saved reports by users.

positions.title: Application Security Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked with security architects to gather information to create standards for Anti-Virus and Firewalls that are implemented on workstations, servers, mail systems, and gateways to avoid threats of viruses and installing of malicious softwares
•	Reviewed security baselines to ensure that consistency was maintained for different versions of softwares to avoid duplicates

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked through Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) phases in a group to create a web     application to track CDB Online updates made by users and displaying a graphical representation of the data
•	Dealt with System Analysts to understand the specifications for the web application and created the front end of the user web application using Java and HTML
•	Created a database and ensured efficiency for the data that was shown in a graphical representation

projects.title: Robotic Surveillance System
projects.description:
Portable video surveillance system for easy and rapid deployment virtually anywhere; controlled via android phone/computer.
-	Designed circuit using arduino, multisim, ip camera, sensors, bluetooth, access points, etc
-	Teamed with 3 engineering fellow students to prepare project proposal document, functional requirement document and test scripts.
-	Programmed arduino motherboard using C
-	Integrated LED driver circuit for signage
